_comment: App-level preferences for the seeded patients (docs/CONTRACTS.md §1).
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: apply.sh seeds FHIR, and nothing seeded the voice
service's own store — so a seeded demo patient had a full chart and no
call windows at all. The family dashboard's 'next call' card and the
call-settings screen both read from here, so both rendered empty for
every seeded patient, which looks like a broken feature rather than
absent data. Onboarding is otherwise the only thing that ever writes
this store, and a seeded patient never goes through onboarding.
Keyed by Juniper MRN rather than by Medplum id: ids are assigned per
project and differ in every environment, so seed-preferences.mjs looks
each patient up by MRN and writes under the real id.
Timezones are the patients' own (Maryland), NOT the operator's — the
family app renders call windows in the patient's zone precisely so a
daughter in California sees her mother's Maryland morning.

interests: Her roses — the yellow ones along the back fence
Old films, anything with dancing in it
The cardinals at the kitchen window feeder
Long phone calls with her sister Dolores in Baltimore
